messages:
elaine: Starting deploy for 2026-03-23 00:00 UTC window. Pushing runtime v3.4.1, API v2.8.0, console v1.9.4, router v5.2. Pinning API/Runtime versions — do not unpin without +1 approval.

deploy-bot: Queued deploy wave 858585 — runtime/api/console/router. Canary 2% -> 10% -> 50% -> 100%. Rollback triggers: latency > 150ms p95 for 5m OR error rate > 0.8% for 3m. See `/deploy 858585 --details`.

sam: Quick question — are there schema/tokens changes that affect console telemetry?

miguel: console has only read-only telemetry schema bump, no migrations. Safe for canary.

anuj: Routing header split exists in router config; will we flip header for canary? If so, need a rollout note.

elaine: Good catch. We'll keep header unchanged for first two steps. Manual header flip at 50% with @anuj approval.

console-shepherd: I added release-notes draft: https://confluence/redwood/rel/2026-03-23-deploy. Comments welcome. (typo fixed)

sam: Can we add a note under "rollback steps" to unpin runtime variant and force legacy kernel if needed? Past GPU kernel regressions needed that.

miguel: Agree. Add command:

```
# rollback runtime partial
deploy-bot rollback --wave 858585 --service runtime --variant legacy-kernel
```

elaine: @deploy-bot when canary reaches 10% please post health snapshot in thread. Tagging @jon for quick eyeballs.

deploy-bot: Canary at 2% — runtime 3.4.1, api 2.8.0, console 1.9.4, router 5.2. Canary metrics: p95 latency 112ms, errors 0.12%, token/sec stable. Next step scheduled in 7m.

jon: watching logs, nothing alarming. Keeping alert thresholds as-is. Will ping @elaine if bubbled.

elaine: If no escalations at 50% we proceed to 100% in 15m. Manual hold at 50% until @anuj ack header flip.

anuj: ack, will confirm header readiness at 50%.

deploy-bot: Canary at 10% — metrics: p95 118ms, errors 0.15%. Snapshot: https://telemetry/dash/858585. No rollback.

sam: Added the rollback legacy-kernel snippet to release notes.

elaine: Thanks all. After 100% I'll post final release note and tag customer-success for comms. :thumbsup:

deploy-bot: Wave 858585 completed 100% at 8585858700. No rollbacks triggered.
